_about: China Module 1 headings from NMPA's Module 1 (administrative documents and drug information) requirements; folders, envelope and rules modelled on the NMPA eCTD Technical Specification V1.0, Validation Standard V1.0 and Implementation Guide V1.0 (Announcement 2021 No. 119; scope widened by Announcement 2025 No. 10). Simplified for training: heading 1.3.4 (traditional Chinese medicine) and the clinical-trial subheadings are left out. Codes carry a 'cn:' prefix in the app.
